Subject: Security-driven deployment checklist + proposed audit sprints

Hi Lily / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Short recap of decisions and immediate asks so we stay aligned on hosting constraints and the evidence pack your compliance team needs.

Call highlights (from our side):
- Greenline requires HIPAA coverage (PHI in PII/PHI flows) and a signed BAA before any production data is processed.
- Primary preference: Hosted API for initial PoC to accelerate time-to-value; potential move to Dedicated capacity or Private VPC for long-term isolation depending on audit outcomes and SLAs.
- Your security team asked for SOC 2 Type II artifacts, encryption details (KMS/HSM), and an architecture/network diagram showing egress rules.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the scope of PHI we will see in the PoC (examples of payloads or sample schema)? — helps us scope data retention & logging controls.
2) Please send the Greenline security questionnaire we discussed (we'll map answers to evidence).
3) We will attach a short table with lead times for Dedicated provisioning and Private/VPC onboarding — karthik will follow.
4) Proposed timeline: PoC on Hosted API (2–3 weeks) while we prepare evidence for BAA + SOC2 package. If Greenline wants Dedicated, expect ~4–6 week lead time for reserved capacity and ~6–10 weeks for Private/VPC depending on networking approvals.

I'll pull together an "audit sprint" checklist (itemized evidence, responsible owner, and ETA) and share by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Evidence split + provisioning lead times for Greenline

Connor / Neha —

Notes and a technical breakdown we can send to Lily (I'll tidy for external):

Overview (quick):
- Hosted API (fastest PoC):
  * Pros: Immediate access, no provisioning lead time, Redwood manages infra and provides SOC2 summary and scoped runtime controls.
  * Cons: Shared tenancy for infrastructure-level resources; we can limit retention and provide redaction hooks but cannot offer dedicated NIC-level isolation.
  * Logs: application logs are encrypted at rest; default retention 30 days, can set to 0–90 days for accounts with controls. We can implement a "post-process purge" for PHI-containing logs during PoC — requires signed BAA and explicit runbook.

- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs/pods):
  * Pros: Tenant-dedicated GPU pools, stronger isolation of runtime, custom autoscale windows, SLA-backed latency.
  * Cons: 4–6 week lead time to reserve and provision depending on region and instance type. Requires network peering if you want private connectivity.
  * Evidence: we can provide instance-level configuration, allocation records, and dedicated tenancy design doc.

- Private VPC / On-prem (long-term):
  * Pros: Full network isolation, customer-managed KMS/HSM, on-prem options for air-gapped needs.
  * Cons: 6–10+ week onboarding (legal, network approvals, infra install).
  * Evidence: full architecture diagrams, audit logs export path, HSM integration notes.

Requested evidence (we can attach a subset immediately):
- SOC2 summary + scope (attached PDF) — immediate
- Control mapping to questionnaire — 48 hours to produce mapping for Greenline_BAA_questions.xlsx
- Network diagram & egress rules template — 3 business days
- BAA draft — legal to share (Connor): 1 business day
- Dedicated capacity lead-time table (attached CSV) — immediate

Proposed external reply (to Lily): include a short table comparing lead times and evidence deliverables, propose the deep-dive slot, and offer Hosted PoC with purge runbook as an interim.

I'll prepare the purge runbook and minimal on-demand logging config for the PoC (scripted steps) — target internal draft EOD today.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clarifications — short plan and proposed schedule below. I've attached the BAA draft to this thread and links to our SOC2 summary and the evidence folder.

Proposed path (minimal friction, audit-conscious):
1) Immediate: Hosted API PoC (2–3 weeks)
   - We will enable an account-level retention override (set to 0 days for logs that include PHI) and provide a purge runbook we execute on request. Karthik will own the runbook.
   - Redwood provides SOC2 summary + control mapping within 48 hours once we receive the questionnaire.
   - Legal: BAA draft attached, please loop your counsel; we can accept some redlines but note changes affecting data handling may need product review.

2) Parallel: Prepare Dedicated evaluation (if you decide to move)
   - Estimated procurement + provisioning: 4–6 weeks from signed commitment (see attached CSV).
   - We will prepare a dedicated tenancy design packet and instance allocation plan for your security review.

3) Private VPC / On-prem: scoped if audits require customer-managed KMS/HSM or network isolation beyond peering.
   - Timeline: 6–10+ weeks; more exact estimate after we get network diagram and procurement window.

Suggested next steps (meeting & deliverables):

- Schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive next Tue 07/28 or Wed 07/29 — suggest Tue 10:00 AM ET. I'll send a calendar invite.
